headline: 《生死时限》《狂热先生》领跑今日影剧
summary: 电影《生死时限》本周热映，剧集《权力的游戏前传：龙族》热度不减，新剧《狂热先生》首播引发关注。待映《生化危机：爆发夜》与待播《怪物：莉齐·博登的故事》同样备受期待。

industryHighlights.text: 电影《生死时限》《大熊雨林》本周强势领跑影院。
industryHighlights.en: Films 'Time Limit' and 'Great Bear Rainforest' are strong box-office leaders this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《狂热先生》首播，与《龙族》等热播剧同台竞逐。
industryHighlights.en: New drama 'Mr. Fanatic' premieres, competing with hits like 'House of the Dragon'.

industryHighlights.text: 《生化危机：爆发夜》《怪物：莉齐·博登的故事》等新作蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming titles like 'Resident Evil: Outbreak Night' and 'Monsters: The Lizzie Borden Story' are on the horizon.

industryHighlights.text: 《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》等热播剧持续占据热度榜单。
industryHighlights.en: Popular series 'The Rookie' and 'Rick and Morty' keep topping the charts.

headlineEn: Time Limit and Mr. Fanatic Lead Today's Screen
summaryEn: Movie 'Time Limit' is hot this week; TV hit 'House of the Dragon' stays strong while new series 'Mr. Fanatic' grabs attention. Upcoming 'Resident Evil: Outbreak Night' and 'Monsters: The Lizzie Borden Story' are highly anticipated.
